يستصبروا (form X)
# يَسْتَصْبِرُوا (yastaṣbirū) /jas.tasˤ.bi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# يُسْتَصْبَرُوا (yustaṣbarū) /jus.tasˤ.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
